en.name: Black bean sauce
en.summary: Black bean sauce is built on salted fermented soybeans, usually with garlic, oil and soy, and the salt is what makes it keep. Unopened it runs about 18–24 months in the cupboard from purchase. After opening, refrigerate it and use it within about 3–6 months.
en.pantry: An unopened jar keeps about 18–24 months from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard away from the hob and out of the sun. Salt and fermentation are doing the preserving here, which is why no refrigeration is needed while the seal is intact. Store jars upright so the oil layer stays on top, and do not keep a jar whose lid has lost its vacuum or whose seal is visibly damaged.
en.fridge: Once opened, keep the jar at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use it within about 3–6 months. Always use a clean, dry spoon — a wet or used one carries in water and food particles, and that is what starts mould on the surface of an otherwise stable sauce. Wipe the rim and the inside of the lid before you close it. The sauce will thicken and the oil may solidify in the cold; let the jar stand a few minutes or stir before use.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for black bean sauce and freezing serves no purpose: it is salty and stable enough to last months in the fridge, which is longer than most households take to finish a jar. Freezing would also separate the oil and coarsen the texture. If you have too much, use it — it is good far beyond stir-fries, in braises, steamed fish and marinades.
spoilage: Fuzzy or coloured mould on the surface or around the rim
A yeasty, alcoholic or sharply sour smell instead of a deep salty-savoury one
A lid that has domed up, or fizzing when the jar is opened
The sauce gone dry, crusted and hard around the edges of the jar
tips: Use a dry spoon every time; water is what spoils a salted sauce.
Write the opening date on the lid.
Wipe the rim before closing so nothing crusts into the thread.
Buy the jar size that matches how often you cook with it.

faq.q: Does black bean sauce need to be refrigerated after opening?
faq.a: Yes. Refrigerate at 4 °C or below and use it within about 3–6 months.

faq.q: How long does unopened black bean sauce last?
faq.a: About 18–24 months from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard, as long as the seal is intact.

faq.q: Can you freeze black bean sauce?
faq.a: There is no timeline and no need. It is salty enough to keep for months refrigerated, and freezing separates the oil.

faq.q: Why has mould formed on my black bean sauce?
faq.a: Almost always a wet or used spoon. Keep the sauce dry, wipe the rim, and use clean utensils every time.

zh.name: 豆豉醬
zh.summary: 豆豉醬以鹽漬發酵的黃豆為基底，通常再加蒜、油和醬油，靠鹽來保存。未開封放在櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 18～24 個月。開封後請冷藏，並在大約 3～6 個月內用完。
zh.pantry: 未開封的罐子放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，遠離爐火與日曬，從購買日起算大約 18～24 個月。這裡做保存工作的是鹽和發酵，所以只要封口完整就不需要冷藏。請直立擺放，讓油層留在上面；蓋子已經沒有真空感或封口明顯損壞的就不要再存放。
zh.fridge: 開封後請放 4 °C 以下，並在大約 3～6 個月內用完。每次都要用乾淨乾燥的湯匙——沾水或用過的湯匙會帶進水分和食物殘渣，而那正是一罐原本很穩定的醬開始長霉的原因。蓋回去之前先擦一下瓶口和蓋子內側。低溫下醬會變稠、油可能凝固；放幾分鐘或攪拌一下再用即可。
zh.freezer: 豆豉醬沒有冷凍期限，冷凍也沒有意義：它夠鹹、夠穩定，冷藏就能放好幾個月，比多數家庭用完一罐的時間還長。冷凍還會讓油分離、口感變粗。用不完的話就多用——它不只能炒，燉肉、蒸魚、做醃料都很好。
spoilage: 醬面或瓶口周圍長出毛狀或有顏色的霉
聞起來有酵母味、酒味或強烈酸味，而不是濃厚的鹹香
蓋子鼓起，或開罐時冒氣
罐緣的醬乾掉、結成硬殼
tips: 每次都用乾燥的湯匙；水才是鹹醬變質的原因。
蓋回去前先擦瓶口，避免醬垢卡進螺紋。
依照自己下廚的頻率選罐子大小。

faq.a: 要。放 4 °C 以下冷藏，並在大約 3～6 個月內用完。

faq.q: 未開封的豆豉醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 只要封口完整，陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃從購買日起算大約 18～24 個月。
沒有對應期限，也沒有必要。它夠鹹，冷藏就能放好幾個月，冷凍反而會讓油分離。
幾乎都是沾水或用過的湯匙造成的。保持乾燥、擦淨瓶口、每次都用乾淨餐具。
